question: The Federation of the Indian Chamber of Commerce and Industries (FICCI) was formed in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1927**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 1927__ the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI) was formed.
 
• The Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI) was founded in 1927 on the advice of Mahatma Gandhi by Indian businessmen G.D. Birla and Purshottamdas Thakurdas.
